guides.title: 工程檔案：關鍵數據、年代、規範與案例
guides.titleEn: Engineering dossier: key figures, timeline, codes and landmarks
guides.concept: 分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋。本頁區分公開工程資料與明示的教學假設；數值只用於學習比較，不是設計值。
guides.conceptEn: Ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation. This dossier distinguishes public project facts from explicitly labelled teaching assumptions; figures are for learning comparisons, not design values.
facts: 教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。

教學假設，非現場設定或設計允收值。假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。

factsEn: Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension.

Teaching assumptions, not operating settings or design acceptance limits. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions.

timeline: 1992　Heathrow Express試驗隧道展示倫敦軟土噴凝土襯砌
2009　美國聯邦公路管理局發布隧道土建技術手冊
2014　Crossrail公開噴凝土設計與Stepney Green案例論文
timelineEn: 1992 — The Heathrow Express trial tunnel demonstrates soft-ground sprayed lining in London
2009 — FHWA issues its tunnel manual covering civil engineering elements
2014 — Crossrail publishes sprayed-lining design and Stepney Green case papers
codes: 美國聯邦公路管理局公路隧道土建技術手冊，2009

codesEn: FHWA road tunnel civil-elements technical manual, 2009
Crossrail sprayed-concrete lining design paper, 2014: case guidance
landmarks: 倫敦Stepney Green洞室：側導坑案例
landmarksEn: London Stepney Green caverns: side-drift case
procedure: 把關鍵數據與本課算例逐項對照，標出哪些是公開工程數據、哪些是教學假設。
沿著工程時間軸，標出設計、施工、事件與維護改造的關鍵決策點，說明每個決策改變了哪一條系統路徑或檢核。
對照列出的規範與標準，找出本課試驗或允收步驟對應的條款類型，並註明版本與適用地區。
從代表工程中選一個與本課比較，列出埋深或斷面、地質水文、支護系統與施工方法的差異。
procedureEn: Compare the key figures with this course's worked example and mark which are public project data and which are teaching assumptions.
Along the timeline, mark the key design, construction, event and retrofit decisions and say which system path or check each one changed.
Against the listed codes and standards, find the kind of clause behind this course's tests or acceptance steps, noting edition and jurisdiction.
Pick one landmark project to compare with this course and list differences in depth or section, ground and groundwater, support system and construction method.
pitfalls: 把四捨五入的公開數據當成設計值或允收值使用。
沒有確認規範版本、適用地區與荷載組合就直接套用另一國的條文。
pitfallsEn: Using rounded public figures as design or acceptance values.
Applying another country's clauses without checking edition, jurisdiction and load combinations.

guides.scope: 依公開工程原理、官方資料與規範架構編寫的原創教學；步驟是可驗證的學習任務與假想算例，不是設計圖說、施工計畫、開挖、注漿或受限空間作業許可，也不是任何專案的設計文件。數值均為教學假設或公開資料，實際工程須由合格技師依規範與實測資料重新計算並簽證。
guides.scopeEn: Original teaching built from public engineering principles, official sources and code frameworks. Steps are verifiable learning tasks and hypothetical exercises, not design drawings, method statements, excavation, grouting or confined-space permits, or any project's design documents. Numbers are teaching assumptions or public data; real work must be recalculated and certified by qualified engineers using codes and measured data.

guides.title: 機制、算例與驗證：隧道分部開挖與支撐
guides.titleEn: Mechanisms, calculations and verification: Sequential excavation and support
guides.concept: 分部開挖讓土岩的卸載、變形與支護成形交錯發生，最終斷面強度不能單獨說明施工期表現。本課以簡化反力曲線建立概念，再逐項檢視開挖面分割、早齡材料、仰拱閉合、收斂與防水介面。學員需用量測檢查每一個模型的邊界，將適配曲線、工程判斷及正式核准清楚區分。
guides.conceptEn: Sequential excavation interleaves unloading, ground movement and support formation, so final-section strength alone cannot explain construction-stage behavior. The course begins with simplified reaction curves and then examines face subdivision, young materials, invert closure, convergence and waterproofing interfaces. Learners test each model boundary against observations and distinguish curve fitting, engineering judgment and formal authorization.
procedure: 地層釋放變形時需求反力可能下降，已成形支護隨變形提供更多反力；交點代表特定簡化假設下的相容狀態。支護啟用前的位移會改變交點，兩條線並不是天然固定的材料常數。 假設u以mm計，pg=0.6-0.02u MPa、ps=0.01(u-10) MPa且u≥10；相等得u=23.33 mm、p=0.133 MPa，僅為線性示例。 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。

分割斷面改變同時暴露的面積與形狀，卻也新增接縫和施工介面。面積減少可能有利於控制某些局部機制，但總斷面與暫時支護仍需共同受力，不能將面積比例直接當作穩定度比例。 假設總斷面80 m²分為30、30、20 m²三部分，最大單部面積30/80=37.5%；每次假設進尺1 m時，最大單部原位開挖30 m³。 相鄰開挖面時間重疊而未更新模型，會形成比圖面預想更大的開放區；局部掉塊或變形增加可能被錯認為偶發材料問題，實際原因卻是施工序列偏離。

新噴襯砌的強度與剛度隨齡期發展，受力開始時間可能早於材料達到長期性能。平均壓應力可檢查數量級，但彎曲、局部薄區與早齡徐變會使同一平均值對不同位置產生不同影響。 假設軸力N=300 kN/m、厚t=0.20 m，單位寬平均應力N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa；若合成試驗強度2 MPa，比值為0.75，未含分項係數。 以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。

非圓斷面或不均勻荷載會使襯砌同時受壓與彎曲，厚度局部減少對彎曲應力的影響大於對平均壓應力的影響。線彈性截面分析只在未裂與適用材料假設下成立，需與真實受力機制分開。 假設每米寬N=200 kN、M=10 kN·m、t=0.25 m，σ=N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa，兩緣為1.76與-0.16 MPa，負值表示拉應力。 局部薄區在彎矩作用下先裂，原有內力分配可能重新調整；只看截面平均壓縮會忽略拉側與接縫開口，進而低估滲水和後續耐久風險。

開口支護和閉合環的力流不同，仰拱接通後可增加環向約束，但接縫柔度與地層接觸仍影響實際剛度。用等效彈簧比較只展示閉合改變，不聲稱結構一定立即成為完整圓環。 假設同一增量荷載ΔF=600 kN，開口等效剛度20 kN/mm、閉合後60 kN/mm，位移增量分別30與10 mm；兩剛度均為教學假設。 圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。

相同軸力作用於不同齡期材料會產生不同彈性應變，而早齡徐變使單純彈性關係更受限制。施工時間表不只是管理資料，它決定各部分材料在荷載轉移時的剛度以及可能的內力再分配。 假設單位寬A=0.25 m²、N=300 kN，E=6 GPa時ε=N/(EA)=200微應變；E=12 GPa時為100微應變，未包含徐變與收縮。 較晚啟用的儀器漏記先期應變，與年輕材料的低剛度疊加後可能誤判荷載很小；若再忽略徐變，內力估計的方向甚至可能和真實變化不同。

指數曲線可以摘要逐漸變慢的合成收斂，但擬合形式不會自動證明地層穩定。開挖距離、地下水和後續拆除都可能改變邊界，造成原先衰減的曲線重新加速，預測必須附帶情境。 假設u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm，t以day計，u(5)=12.64 mm、u(10)=17.29 mm；極限20 mm只是模型參數，非現場允收限值。 將加速讀值當作離群點刪除，會讓擬合曲線看似穩定卻失去預警能力；當邊界已改變，延用舊極限值可能錯估後續變形與需要的審查。
地下水壓力作用於可受壓的面積，防水層負責阻隔水路而非憑空消除外部水壓。排水與封閉防水的設計邊界不同，若把排水假設移植到不排水區，襯砌受力可能被低估。 假設均勻表壓p=150 kPa作用於局部平面A=2 m²，合力F=pA=300 kN；這是假設局部均壓，非整個彎曲襯砌的總合力。 排水通道堵塞後外水壓上升，內表面卻可能暫時仍乾燥；若僅以滲漏量評估荷載，會錯把防水效果良好當成結構沒有水壓需求。

單一位移可能由較大荷載配較高剛度或較小荷載配較低剛度產生，因而不是所有參數都能由一條曲線辨識。反分析必須配合獨立地質、材料與內力量測，並報告可行參數的範圍。 假設u=F/k=10 mm，可由F=500 kN、k=50 kN/mm，也可由F=1000 kN、k=100 kN/mm得到；一個位移觀測無法區分兩組。 校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。

多層襯砌的品質需要逐層追溯，表層完成後會遮蔽接縫、修補與防水介面。缺陷面積比例只能摘要分布，缺陷是否位於力流轉折或滲水路徑比總百分比更影響後續檢查。 假設檢查面積200 m²、已確認需處置區8 m²，面積比8/200=4%；若其中2 m²位於關鍵接縫，不能被其餘192 m²良好區平均掉。 覆蓋後失去定位資訊會使後續滲漏無法連回原缺陷，維修只能猜測路徑；關鍵區域若被總體低缺陷率掩蓋，耐久與可維修性的問題便會延後暴露。
procedureEn: Ground reaction demand may decrease as displacement develops, while installed support mobilizes increasing resistance. Their intersection is a compatible state under specified simplifying assumptions. Displacement before installation changes that state; neither line is a universal material constant. Assume displacement u in mm, pg=0.6-0.02u MPa and ps=0.01(u-10) MPa for u≥10. Equating them gives u=23.33 mm and p=0.133 MPa, a linear illustration only. Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable.

Subdivision changes simultaneously exposed area and shape while creating joints and construction interfaces. A smaller face can help control some local mechanisms, but the complete section and temporary supports still interact. Area ratios cannot directly represent stability ratios. Assume an 80 m² section divided into 30, 30 and 20 m² parts. The largest part is 30/80=37.5%; at an assumed 1 m increment its in-situ excavation is 30 m³. Overlapping adjacent excavations without updating the model creates a larger open region than planned. Increased movement or local falls may then be misclassified as isolated material problems when the underlying issue is a departure from the intended sequence.

Fresh sprayed lining gains strength and stiffness with age and may carry load before reaching long-term properties. Mean compressive stress checks scale, but bending, thin zones and early creep can make an identical mean stress have different implications at different locations. Assume axial force N=300 kN/m and thickness t=0.20 m. Unit-width mean stress N/t=1500 kPa=1.5 MPa. Against synthetic test strength 2 MPa, the ratio is 0.75 before any partial factors. Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier.

Noncircular geometry and uneven loads produce compression and bending together. Local thinning affects bending stress more strongly than mean compression. Linear-elastic section analysis applies only under its uncracked material assumptions and must be separated from the full ground-lining mechanism. For a 1 m strip assume N=200 kN, M=10 kN·m and t=0.25 m. Stress is N/t±6M/t²=0.8±0.96 MPa: edges are 1.76 and -0.16 MPa, with negative indicating tension. A thin zone may crack first under bending and redistribute internal forces. Looking only at mean compression overlooks the tensile edge and joint opening, potentially understating leakage and subsequent durability concerns.

Open support and a closed ring have different load paths. Invert connection can add circumferential restraint, but joint compliance and ground contact still govern effective stiffness. Equivalent springs illustrate the change without claiming that closure instantly creates a perfect circular ring. Assume the same incremental force ΔF=600 kN. With equivalent stiffness 20 kN/mm before closure and 60 kN/mm after, displacement increments are 30 and 10 mm; both stiffnesses are teaching assumptions. A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.

Equal axial force produces different elastic strain in materials of different age, while early creep further limits a purely elastic relation. The construction timetable is therefore a mechanical input: it determines stiffness during load transfer and potential redistribution among components. Assume unit-width area A=0.25 m² and N=300 kN. At E=6 GPa, ε=N/(EA)=200 microstrain; at E=12 GPa it is 100 microstrain, excluding creep and shrinkage. Late gauge activation misses earlier strain and, combined with low young-material stiffness, can suggest falsely small loading. Ignoring creep adds further bias and may make the inferred force trend differ from the actual load-transfer history.

An exponential curve can summarize synthetic convergence that slows with time, but its fitted form does not prove stability. Excavation distance, groundwater and later removals can change boundaries and restart acceleration. A forecast must therefore state the scenario under which it applies. Assume u(t)=20[1-exp(-t/5)] mm with t in days. Values are u(5)=12.64 mm and u(10)=17.29 mm; the 20 mm asymptote is a model parameter, not a field acceptance limit. Deleting accelerating readings as outliers can make a fitted curve look stable while removing its warning value. After boundaries change, retaining the old asymptote may misrepresent future movement and the need for engineering review.

Groundwater pressure acts over the pressurized area. Waterproofing blocks water paths rather than making external pressure disappear. Drained and sealed arrangements have different boundaries; applying a drainage assumption to a sealed region can understate lining demand. Assume uniform gauge pressure p=150 kPa on local plane area A=2 m². Resultant F=pA=300 kN applies to this idealized local patch, not the entire curved lining. After drainage blocks, external pressure may rise while the inner surface remains dry. Assessing loading from leakage alone can mistake effective waterproofing for the absence of a water-pressure demand on the structure.

The same displacement can result from larger force with higher stiffness or smaller force with lower stiffness. A single curve therefore cannot identify every parameter. Back-analysis needs independent geological, material and force evidence and should report feasible parameter ranges. An observed u=F/k=10 mm can arise from F=500 kN with k=50 kN/mm or F=1000 kN with k=100 kN/mm. One displacement observation cannot distinguish the two pairs. A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability.

Layered lining needs traceability by layer because the final surface hides joints, repairs and waterproofing interfaces. Defect-area fraction summarizes distribution, but whether a defect lies at a load-path change or water route matters more than the overall percentage. Assume inspected area 200 m² and confirmed treatment area 8 m²: the fraction is 8/200=4%. If 2 m² lies at critical joints, the 192 m² of satisfactory area cannot average that issue away. Losing location information after covering a layer prevents later leaks from being linked to original defects. Repairs then rely on guesses, while a low overall defect rate can hide critical zones and postpone durability and maintainability problems.
evidence: 每次比較先列出啟用位移、材料齡期與三維效應的處理方式，將模型結果交設計者連同失效模式審查，不能以曲線交點自行批准下一步開挖。
每日圖面同時標出已開挖、已支護和已閉合區，不只標累計進尺；任何部分重疊或順序調整，都須由現場技術負責人送設計審查。
交接表以齡期而非僅以日期配對荷載和試驗，未知早齡性能要明列；下一施工階段是否可開始，由核准的材料與結構審查流程判定。
圖表分別列軸力、彎矩和兩緣應力，保留正負號定義；出現開裂可能性時交設計者決定後續驗證與模型，不能只用平均值完成驗收。
閉合紀錄同時確認幾何、接縫、齡期和核准試驗，未完成項不以照片代替；臨時支護調整前由結構負責人確認實際傳力條件。
evidenceEn: Before each comparison, list installation displacement, material age and treatment of three-dimensional effects. The designer reviews the model together with failure modes; an intersection alone cannot authorize the next excavation stage.

Daily drawings distinguish excavated, supported and closed regions instead of showing accumulated advance alone. Any overlap or sequence change is referred by the site technical lead for design review.

Pair loading and tests by material age, not date alone, and explicitly list unknown early-age properties. Permission to begin the next stage follows the approved material and structural review process.

Report axial force, moment and both edge stresses separately, preserving the sign convention. When cracking is possible, the designer determines further verification and modeling; a mean value cannot close acceptance.

Closure records verify geometry, joints, age and approved tests together. Photographs do not replace unresolved checks. Before altering temporary support, the structural lead confirms the actual load-transfer conditions.
pitfalls: 把未觀測的先期變形設為零，會高估支護參與程度並錯估交點；即使後續曲線看似吻合，起始條件錯誤仍可能造成對施工變更的錯誤預測。
以二十八天強度取代初齡性能會掩蓋早期需求超過能力的時段，外表未裂也不能排除內部損傷；之後補足強度不會自動抹去既有裂縫和接縫缺陷。
圖面已閉合但接縫未充分傳力，會讓計算剛度高於實際；若據此移除臨時構件，變形可能重新加速，顯示幾何閉合與力學閉合並不相同。
將加速讀值當作離群點刪除，會讓擬合曲線看似穩定卻失去預警能力；當邊界已改變，延用舊極限值可能錯估後續變形與需要的審查。
校準到單一斷面的模型可能只是參數互相補償，換到新地層或新序列便失準；若只公布最佳誤差不公布多解性，使用者會高估模型的預測能力。
pitfallsEn: Setting unobserved pre-installation movement to zero can overstate support participation and misplace the intersection. A visually good later fit does not remove that initial-condition error or make predictions of a changed sequence reliable.

Using mature strength for young lining hides intervals when demand may exceed available resistance. A crack-free surface does not exclude internal damage, and later strength gain does not automatically remove cracks or joint defects formed earlier.

A geometrically closed section with ineffective joints can be less stiff than assumed. Removing temporary members on that assumption may restart movement, demonstrating that geometric closure and effective structural closure are different conditions.

Deleting accelerating readings as outliers can make a fitted curve look stable while removing its warning value. After boundaries change, retaining the old asymptote may misrepresent future movement and the need for engineering review.

A model calibrated to one section may rely on compensating parameters and fail under a new ground condition or sequence. Reporting only its best error while hiding non-uniqueness encourages overconfidence in predictive capability.

related.title: 敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐
related.titleEn: Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs
related.transfer: 可遷移「地層支護曲線交點」與「收斂曲線與外推界線」的傳力分析、量測與驗證方法；敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐的跨度、荷載、材料與允收條件需重新設定。
related.transferEn: The load-path analysis, measurement and verification methods of "Ground-support curve intersection" and "Convergence curves and extrapolation limits" transfer, while ground conditions, loads, materials and acceptance conditions of Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs must be respecified.
related.difference: 本課聚焦分部開挖的地層支護互制、早齡襯砌與觀測回饋；敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐則以敞開硬岩掘進後方的暴露跨度、岩塊支護與證據閉合為重點，不能直接沿用參數或允收值。
related.differenceEn: This course focuses on ground-support interaction, early-age lining and observational feedback in sequential excavation; Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs centres on exposure, block support and evidence closure behind open hard-rock TBMs, so parameters and acceptance values do not transfer unchanged.
practice: 比較系統邊界：列出「地層支護曲線交點」與「頂拱岩塊與自重路徑」的荷載來源、傳力路徑與主要環境作用。
把本課算例的一個假設移到敞開式硬岩掘進機支撐，標出可沿用的方程與必須重設的參數。
以「超挖體積與出碴核對」為例，設計一項能區分兩種結構行為的試驗或量測，並註明不確定度與允收準則。
practiceEn: Compare system boundaries: list the load sources, load paths and main environmental actions of “Ground-support curve intersection” and “Crown blocks and self-weight path”.
Move one assumption of this course's worked example to Support installation behind open hard-rock TBMs, separating reusable equations from parameters that must be respecified.
Using "Overbreak volume and muck reconciliation", design a test or measurement that distinguishes the two structural behaviours and state its uncertainty and acceptance criterion.

history.year: 公開工程脈絡 / Public engineering context
history.title: 隧道分部開挖與支撐
history.text: Crossrail的公開論文把噴凝土襯砌與地層互制及施工序列放在同一設計問題中，並回顧一九九二年Heathrow Express試驗隧道的軟土地下施工。二〇〇九年FHWA土建手冊提供另一套工程背景，二〇一四年公開的Stepney Green論文呈現側導坑序列與量測比較。這些文獻並不支持把某個縮短步距或增加厚度當成萬用解法；本課追蹤的是每一次邊界改變如何影響可觀測的力流。
history.textEn: Crossrail authors treat sprayed lining, ground interaction and construction sequence as one design problem, and discuss the 1992 Heathrow Express soft-ground trial tunnel. The 2009 FHWA civil manual provides another engineering reference, while the 2014 Stepney Green paper presents side-drift sequencing with monitoring comparisons. None makes a shorter advance or thicker lining a universal solution. This course instead follows how each changed boundary alters the load path and the observations needed to test it.
